items.name: Vegas Cubing Cup Fall 2025

venue.name: The Orleans Hotel & Casino
venue.address: 4500 W Tropicana Ave, Las Vegas, NV 89103

items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VegasCubingCupFall2025#62687-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.

This competition is sponsored by [SpeedCubeShop](http://speedcubeshop.com) and [West Coast Cubing](http://westcoastcubing.com)

items.name: Mahalo iā Maui 2025
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NDgyNDQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--d739808be3a2373fd1129978150c3798d3405ee0/IMG_1309.png)
### Come join us for our annual WCA competition on the beautiful island of Maui!

* It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
* Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) will provide you with most of the information you need.
* If you are a first time competitor it is highly encouraged to be present for the competitor tutorial at 8:30 AM.

items.name: Carolina Clock 'Stravaganza 2025

venue.name: 5th & Washington Event Center
venue.address: 103 C South 5th Street Mebane, North Carolina

items.information:
**This competition does NOT have the standard 3x3x3 Cube event.**

**All competitors must read the [Competitor Information tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CarolinaClockStravaganza2025#62048-competitor-information) prior to registering.**
Please read all tabs prior to the competition and regularly check your email for updates from us. All contact will be made by email.

A t-shirt is included with registration. Please include your t-shirt size in the comment on your registration.

**Due to space limitations, each competitor is only allowed to bring ONE guest with them to the competition.** Yes, parents and siblings count as guests.

This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing Inc](https://southeastcubing.org/about)
